# medit

> medit is a free, open-source AI music editor (DAW) and MCP server. An AI agent (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, any Model Context Protocol client) or a person with a mouse can compose, arrange, mix, master and export songs with the same operations.

- Install: `uv tool install medit-mcp`, then `medit ui` (web DAW on http://127.0.0.1:8780)
- MCP (stdio): `claude mcp add medit -- uvx medit-mcp`
- MCP (live, song open in browser): http://127.0.0.1:8780/mcp/
- Agent workflow: project_create -> structure -> add_drums / add_chords / add_bassline / add_melody -> set_instrument / add_effect / add_bus + set_send -> preview + analyze_mix -> review_song -> balance_mix / auto_master -> export_audio
- 95 MCP tools, 31 built-in sounds, 31 effects, 22 effect chains, 14 drum genres
- License: MIT. Author: metiu (https://metiu.xyz)
